en.headline: RIMOWA aluminium pop-up continues at Harbour City until 22 November
en.dek: The limited installation in Gateway Arcade traces more than a century of aluminium craftsmanship through four zones, open daily from 11am to 9pm.
body: A limited-run RIMOWA pop-up titled A Lifetime of Aluminium is running at Atrium II in the Gateway Arcade of Harbour City in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The installation, shaped like a giant silver case inspired by the brand's grooved aluminium suitcases, guides visitors through four zones that cover more than a century of aluminium craftsmanship and travel-inspired design.
The public run continues until 22 November, with daily opening hours from 11am to 9pm. Harbour City is the organiser.
The pop-up has been open since 13 November.

zh.headline: RIMOWA鋁製行李箱主題快閃展於海港城延續至22日
zh.dek: 閘道廣場中庭的限時裝置以四個區域追溯逾百年鋁材工藝，每日上午11時至晚上9時開放。
body: 以「A Lifetime of Aluminium」為題的RIMOWA限時快閃展覽，正在尖沙咀海港城閘道廣場中庭二期舉行。
裝置仿照品牌溝紋鋁製行李箱，外形如巨型銀色箱子，帶領訪客穿越四個區域，展示逾百年鋁材工藝及旅行設計。
公眾開放期延續至11月22日，每日上午11時至晚上9時開放。主辦單位為海港城。
